title: Senior Manager (Corporate Communications & PR)
description:
Job description


Senior Manager (Corporate Communications & PR)
 
Your role in summary
The Senior Manager is a pivotal role within our team, responsible for developing and executing communication strategies and action plans. In this capacity, you will act as the principal point of contact for our clients, ensuring their satisfaction and retention through dedicated service and the application of V+O principles and values. This role requires close collaboration with the Director/ Business Unit Director, and involves a strong focus on client advisory, especially in areas of corporate communications, public affairs, policy research and analysis.
Key Responsibilities:

Develop and manage corporate communication strategies and action plans under the direction of the Director/ Business Unit Director.
Advise clients on public affairs and stakeholder engagement in coordination with the Director/ Business Unit Director.
Build, manage, and nurture existing client relationships, ensuring continual deepening of these relationships through client satisfaction, development, and retention.
Serve as the project owner for the portfolio, maintaining client KPIs and reports, and proposing actionable recommendations based on outcomes.
Proactively anticipate client needs and provide relevant, timely recommendations.
Responsible for creating all copywriting materials (Press Releases, Q&A documents, interviews, speeches) in line with agreed strategy.
Build and maintain strong relationships and networks with the media and other stakeholders per client needs.
Oversee client’s press office activities under the supervision of Director/ Business Unit Director.
Organize and ensure the timely, budget-compliant completion of all project deliverables.
Support crisis communications under the supervision of Director/ Business Unit Director.
Conduct research on policy issues at national, European, and international levels, and monitor legislation and regulations relevant to client’s business interests.
Undertake the people manager role, managing, training, guiding, and developing team members in accordance with company values and management processes.
Cooperate with external providers, ensuring performance and compliance with company policies.
Manage the completion of all client-related administrative tasks (databases, ISO files, etc.) on time and in accordance with company policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS: 
Education & Experience 
 
Essential
- University degree in Business Administration, Media Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or Political Science
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Greek and English
- Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in a PR firm or in a Corporate Communication Department
Desirable 
- A master's or advanced degree in a relevant field, demonstrating a higher level of expertise.
- Advanced experience in crisis communications
Join us for a challenging career! 
We offer an exciting business framework for you to accelerate professionally as well as a competitive remuneration package and benefits both numerical and non-numerical. We work with great clients, from SMB to global corporations, on a variety of communication challenges, to create compelling and persuasive experiences through insightful planning, innovative thinking, and seamless execution.
If you want to become a member of our team, please send us your CV at careers@vando.gr 
 
Your application will be handled with the utmost confidentiality!

title: Database Administrator (Hybrid)
description:
To meet our current corporate needs, we would like to bring to our team a..

 Senior Database Administrator (DBA)

As a member of the Database Administration team you will be responsible for the installation, configuration and maintenance of the INTRALOT Group Databases. Additionally, you will need to think and develop solutions to sometimes unique issues, by using our available tools and technologies. You will also need to provide your support and technical expertise to any database-related problem that may come up!

More specifically, the successful candidate will undertake to:
Administration: in this role, you will install, configure & maintain Databases of various flavors on Premises, Cloud or Hybrid (MySQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL), implement database-related security measures, and conduct research for new applications on Database technology for INTRALOT projects around the world.
Operations & Monitoring:  you will be responsible to operate & monitor databases as well as develop relevant operations & monitoring techniques.
Documentation & Support: developing & maintaining technical documentation is a must in this position. Provide 3rd level support services, addressing related incidents and service requests.
Software development team support: assist the SW Developmnt team withdata changes, cloning, relocation, performance issues, query optimizations, configuration changes, updates and troubleshooting.
Escalate to Vendors by opening coherent service requests to request their help to resolve issues.

Key Challenges of our job opening:
You will be joining a team that manages corporate database systems of high complexity, multiple versions and large data volumes!
Handling rapid changes and product transformations which must be evaluated quickly.
Thus, in this role, you need to keep yourself up to date & aligned with new technologies!
Please note that in this role requires to work on shifts, including weekends (standby support)To be a successful candidate, your profile should match the following criteria:
Ideally, you have earned your University / College Degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering or relevant technology field.
A proven record of minimum five (5) years working experience
in database administration.
Advanced knowledge of MySQL or Oracle RDBMS is required.
Additional knowledge in one or more of the following database technologies: PostgreSQL, Oracle RDBMS, MongoDB, MS SQL Server etc. will be considered a plus
Good knowledge of scripting and programming languages as well as linux tools, such as Bash, Python, Ansible, awk, sed, etc.
An automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) mindset
You have excellent command of the Greek & English language, both written and spoken 
Completed military obligations for male candidates.
On a personal side... 
You are able to develop and maintain solid technical documentation.You accustomed to working under pressure to meet tight deadlines, whenever needed 
You are also distinguished for your problem-solving abilities and for your strong sense of prioritizing! 
 we work, above everything else, as a TEAM. So, you are an excellent team player, good in communicating and willing to cooperate efficiently with other colleagues!
INTRALOT's vision is to attract the most talented people in our industry and to support and develop them not only to fulfill their role description but also to go beyond expectations!

title: Front Office Receptionist
description:
Job brief
We are looking for a pleasant Front Desk Representative to undertake all receptionist and clerical duties at the desk of our main entrance. You will be the “face” of the company for all visitors and will be responsible for the first impression we make.
The ideal candidate will have a friendly and easy going personality while also being very perceptive and disciplined. You should be able to deal with complaints and give accurate information. A customer-oriented approach is essential.
The goal is to make guests and visitors feel comfortable and valued while on our premises
 
Responsibilities

Greet and welcome guests
Monitor appointments and direct visitors
Answer, screen and forward incoming phone calls
Provide basic and accurate information in-person and via phone
Receive letters, packages etc. and distribute them
Performing ad-hoc administrative duties
Ensure reception area is presentable
Monitor office supplies and place orders when necessary
Take up other duties as assigned

 
Requirements and skills

Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, and Outlook.
Familiarity with office machines (e.g. printer etc.)
Knowledge of office management
Strong communication and people skills
Good organizational and multi-tasking abilities
Problem-solving skills
Customer service orientation
Proficient in English (oral and written)
High School diploma; additional qualifications will be a plus

Proven experience as receptionist, front desk representative, agent or relevant position will be consider as an asset.
